segments.title: Birds get TICKS too
segments.say: Birds get ticks too. And they can hide anywhere.

segments.title: Not just head and ears
segments.say: People thought ticks stayed around the head and ears. So scientists checked the whole bird.

segments.title: One morning's catch
segments.say: One morning they caught a cardinal. A catbird. And a brown thrasher.

segments.title: Literally ANYWHERE
segments.say: The tick could be literally anywhere on the bird, says Professor Scott Loss.

segments.title: One deer: THOUSANDS
segments.say: And a single white-tailed deer can carry thousands of ticks.
Follow for Weird Animal number 12 tonight.
